summary: This study tests how a drug called Liraglutide affects children aged 6 to 12 years who have severe obesity. The trial compares a group getting the drug plus lifestyle changes against a group getting lifestyle changes alone. It is a Phase 4 study with 30 participants and is sponsored by University of Sao Paulo General Hospital. The current status of the trial is Active, not recruiting.

facts.sponsor: University of Sao Paulo General Hospital
